claims.text: The driver's GPS trace is impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07. Between the 18:35:00 fix and the 18:42:08 fix there is a single 428.0-second gap between consecutive fixes — more than four times the 90-second limb in POL-RD-07(a) — and coverage is 81.7% against a 90.0% threshold (LOW_COVERAGE). I disclose the impairment on the face of this claim: EV-GPS-00110 carries weight_multiplier 0.39 and issue codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE, so it is not clean evidence and may not be presented as such.

The 428-second gap is not an incidental dropout at the fringes of the trip — it is the disputed stretch itself. It runs from the Defu Flyover portal fix to the Kallang portal fix, 6.90 km apart in a straight line, and covers the entire KPE segment the rider challenges. Under POL-RD-07(i) the only distance that may be measured across that stretch is the straight line between the bounding fixes, which is expressly the reading most favourable to the driver, so the trace systematically understates the distance actually driven.

Measured the pro-driver way, the trace gives 21.20 km against a booked optimal of 18.4 km — an excess of 2.8 km, or 15.2%. That clears POL-RD-01's 0.8 km absolute limb comfortably but falls below its 20% relative limb, so whether this trip deviates at all turns entirely on the reading taken across the broken 6.9 km stretch.

The admissibility assessment of that same artifact records that a surface route between those two identical portals would put the trip at 25.50 km, which is over both POL-RD-01 limbs, and that nothing in the bundle distinguishes the tunnel reading from the surface reading. The rider should not be made to lose the percentage limb on a measurement artefact created by the very gap that makes the trace unreliable; on the surface reading the excess is roughly 7.1 km against the 18.4 km optimal, well over 20% and over 0.8 km.

No independent corroboration of a deviation exists under POL-RD-07(ii), so the deviation cannot be established on this record and the rider cannot be defeated on it either. The chat log carries no driver admission: its only two messages are 'going KPE ah boss' and 'ok', and the log is impaired — EV-CHAT-00110 carries weight 0.6 with issue code TRUNCATED_LOG, so everything said after 18:26:14, 2186 seconds before the trip ended, is simply absent from the export and its silence proves nothing.

There is no gantry corroboration either. The fare breakdown's erp_gantries field is null against a non-zero tolls_erp of 3.00 (EV-FARE-00110 is impaired, weight 0.75, issue code PARTIAL_RECORD), so no set of charged gantries can be used to place the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use. The one artifact POL-RD-07(ii) needs to carry the corroboration is empty.

The counterparty statement does not admit a deviation. The driver says only that he 'took the KPE like always' — and the KPE is precisely the corridor the booked optimal route itself uses, the trip_record recording the optimal as 'KPE then ECP, crossing both gantries'. A statement that the driver travelled the optimal corridor cannot corroborate a departure from it under POL-RD-07(ii).

The trip_record cannot supply the independent distance POL-RD-07(ii) asks for. Its actual_distance_km of 21.20 is identical to the trace figure and, as the admissibility note states, is itself derived from the impaired trace; POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the governing field and bars actual_distance_km from the threshold test. The platform therefore holds no unimpaired measurement of this trip's distance at all.

With the trace impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c) and no corroborating artifact of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names anywhere on the record, POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) are engaged. The Judge must not issue a final ruling: the case must ESCALATE to a human reviewer with the disputed amount held rather than collected. Absence of proof here is a data failure, not a finding for the driver, and the clause says in terms that the outcome is ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION.

The driver's explanation — that his phone loses signal in the tunnel — is an external-cause assertion, and POL-RD-13 requires such an assertion to be tested against the traffic_advisory for this trip and nothing else. EV-ADVIS-00110-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT: no LTA advisory covers the KPE or the ECP in the 18:19-19:02 window. The comparison cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and under POL-RD-08 the assertion carries no weight and neither reduces the measured excess nor supplies an amended optimal.

On a rider-filed dispute, NO_ACTION is party-relative and leaves the charge exactly where it is: fare_breakdown.payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00, so the full $34.42 stays collected. ESCALATE is the only outcome available on this record that holds the disputed amount rather than collecting it. The rider asks for the escalation the impaired evidence compels, and does not ask the tribunal to invent a threshold finding the trace cannot support.

POL-RD-08's enhanced-corroboration condition cannot be turned against this rider. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, far short of the four-claims-and-one-or-fewer-substantiated test, so no corroboration beyond the gps_trace may be demanded of this claim on profile grounds, and POL-GEN-01 confines the field to that one test.

claims.text: No deviation is established under POL-RD-01. The governing figure is gps_trace.trace_distance_km, 21.2 km, against the booked optimal of 18.4 km — an excess of 2.8 km, or 15.2% of optimal. POL-RD-01 requires the excess to exceed BOTH 20% of optimal and 0.8 km; the percentage gate fails, so no deviation exists and the rider's claim falls at the threshold. Disclosed: EV-GPS-00110 is IMPAIRED (GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE) at weight 0.39; the impairment sits inside the tunnel gap and does not alter the driver-favourable total that POL-RD-07(i) mandates.

The sole gap in the trace is a 428-second dropout inside the KPE tunnel, far over POL-RD-07's 90-second limb, so the trace is impaired for policy purposes. POL-RD-07(i) then fixes the excess across that stretch as the straight line between the bounding fixes — the reading most favourable to the driver — producing the same 21.2 km total, still under the POL-RD-01 gate. No surface-route figure appears in the trace, and nothing in the bundle supports the 25.50 km hypothesis. Disclosed: EV-GPS-00110 is IMPAIRED (GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE) at weight 0.39.

POL-RD-08 places the initial burden on the rider to show an excess above the POL-RD-01 threshold, measured from an unimpaired trace or from an independent source of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names. The rider does neither: her claim concedes she 'did not watch the route' and states no measurement at all, and every distance figure in the bundle is the trace or a copy of it. Disclosed: the trace, EV-GPS-00110, is IMPAIRED (GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE) at weight 0.39.

No independent source corroborates any detour. The chat log records the driver announcing 'going KPE ah boss' — the KPE, which trip_record.optimal_route_source confirms lies on the optimal corridor ('optimal is KPE then ECP') — and the rider answering 'ok'; nothing admits a diversion, and the export was truncated before any later messages. Disclosed: EV-CHAT-00110 is IMPAIRED (TRUNCATED_LOG) at weight 0.6, and EV-FARE-00110's distance_charged_km of 21.20 copies the trace figure, so it is not independent corroboration under POL-RD-07(ii).

Nothing falls to be corrected under POL-RD-09(4). The $3.00 of ERP charged equals the trip record's optimal_route_erp_sgd of $3.00 on the KPE-ECP optimal route, so it is a pass-through on the corridor actually optimal, not a phantom gantry the trace never crossed. Disclosed: EV-FARE-00110 is IMPAIRED (PARTIAL_RECORD) at weight 0.75; the absent gantry itemisation is a record gap, not a wrongly charged line.

Even if the rider's figures were accepted and a material deviation found, POL-RD-06's pattern test fails: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 744 completed_trips_90d, so no pattern is established and neither the FULL_REFUND uplift nor the conduct referral follows. POL-GEN-01 confines that test to deviation_flags_90d and makes the lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter context only.

The disposition that protects the driver is to leave the charge standing: the rider filed, fare_breakdown.payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00, so NO_ACTION preserves the fare the driver earned under POL-GEN-03. And on no view does the rider recover — POL-RD-07(iii) directs that a claim left unproven by an impaired trace be held rather than paid, and POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at the 0.39 weight the deciding distance carries. Disclosed: EV-GPS-00110 is IMPAIRED (GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE) at weight 0.39.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: I cannot decide this trip from the evidence, so under POL-RD-10 the case goes to a human reviewer and the S$34.42 stays held — neither collected nor refunded — until it is resolved.

The problem is the GPS trace (EV-GPS-00110). It drops out for a single 428-second gap, from 18:35:00 to 18:42:08, straight across the KPE tunnel — the very stretch in dispute — and covers only 81.7% of the trip window. That is more than four times POL-RD-07's 90-second limit, so the trace is impaired for policy purposes, not merely flagged by the pre-pass. It carries weight 0.39 with issue codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE.

Two things follow. First, distance across that gap can only be read as the straight line between the bounding fixes: 21.20 km for the trip, 2.8 km over the booked optimal of 18.4 km, or 15.2%. On that reading POL-RD-01's 20% gate fails and no deviation appears — as the driver says. But the admissibility note records that a surface route between the same two portals would give 25.50 km, over both gates, and nothing in the bundle distinguishes the two readings. The one measurement that decides the case is therefore unreliable in the direction that matters.

Second, POL-RD-07(ii) forbids establishing a deviation on an impaired trace alone; it needs an independent source. There is none. The chat log (EV-CHAT-00110, weight 0.6, TRUNCATED_LOG) holds only 'going KPE ah boss' and 'ok' and is cut off after 18:26:14, so its silence proves nothing. The fare breakdown's gantry itemisation is null (EV-FARE-00110, weight 0.75, PARTIAL_RECORD), so it places the car nowhere. The driver's statement that he 'took the KPE like always' describes the optimal corridor itself (trip_record.optimal_route_source: 'optimal is KPE then ECP'), not a departure from it. And the trip record's 21.20 km is a copy of the trace figure, not an independent measurement.

That combination — trace impaired under POL-RD-07(a), and no corroboration of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names — is exactly POL-RD-10(3), and POL-RD-07(iii) directs the outcome to be ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION, because the missing evidence is a data failure, not a finding for the driver. My confidence is capped by the trace at 0.39, below the 0.70 floor, which is also a POL-RD-10(1) trigger.

On the claims. The driver's threshold arithmetic (excess 2.8 km / 15.2% under the straight-line reading) is accepted as the pro-driver measurement POL-RD-07(i) mandates, but it does not decide, because the trace is impaired and POL-RD-07(iii)/POL-RD-10(3) govern. The driver's point that the rider has shown no excess from an unimpaired source is accepted, and is the reason the case escalates rather than being dismissed. The driver's POL-RD-09(4) point is accepted: the S$3.00 of ERP equals the trip record's optimal_route_erp_sgd of S$3.00, so there is no phantom gantry and no billing-integrity referral. The driver's POL-RD-06 point is accepted: deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 744 completed trips in 90 days, so no repeat-deviation pattern is established and no conduct referral follows; POL-GEN-01 confines that test to those two fields, and the lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter is context only.

The rider's no-corroboration points — chat log, gantry itemisation, counterparty statement, trip record — are accepted and are the ground of the escalation. Her POL-RD-13 point is accepted so far as it goes: no LTA advisory (EV-ADVIS-00110-01, weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) covers the window, so POL-RD-03 cannot run and the driver's tunnel-signal explanation carries no weight under POL-RD-08; but the deciding defect here is the impaired trace, not the missing advisory. Her POL-RD-08 profile point is accepted: deviation_claims_60d is 1 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, so no extra corroboration may be demanded on profile grounds.

No referral issues: POL-RD-06(c) does not fire (no pattern), POL-RD-09(4) does not fire (the ERP line is matched), and an escalation under POL-RD-10 is terminal rather than a referral.

What would settle it: a complete GPS trace across the KPE segment for 18:35-18:42 on 22 July 2026, or any independent measurement of the distance driven; alternatively the LTA traffic advisory for the 18:19-19:02 window.

It runs from the Defu Flyover portal fix to the Kallang portal fix, 6.90 km apart in a straight line, and covers the entire KPE segment the rider challenges. Under POL-RD-07(i) the only distance that may be measured across that stretch is the straight line between the bounding fixes, which is expressly the reading most favourable to the driver, so the trace systematically understates the distance actually driven.
ledger.detail: the claim cites impaired artifact EV-GPS-00110 at weight_multiplier 0.39 but does not name its issue code(s): GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE

ledger.claim: Measured the pro-driver way, the trace gives 21.20 km against a booked optimal of 18.4 km — an excess of 2.8 km, or 15.2%. That clears POL-RD-01's 0.8 km absolute limb comfortably but falls below its 20% relative limb, so whether this trip deviates at all turns entirely on the reading taken across the broken 6.9 km stretch.
ledger.detail: the claim cites impaired artifact EV-GPS-00110 at weight_multiplier 0.39 but does not name its issue code(s): GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE

ledger.claim: The admissibility assessment of that same artifact records that a surface route between those two identical portals would put the trip at 25.50 km, which is over both POL-RD-01 limbs, and that nothing in the bundle distinguishes the tunnel reading from the surface reading. The rider should not be made to lose the percentage limb on a measurement artefact created by the very gap that makes the trace unreliable; on the surface reading the excess is roughly 7.1 km against the 18.4 km optimal, well over 20% and over 0.8 km.
ledger.detail: the claim cites impaired artifact EV-GPS-00110 at weight_multiplier 0.39 but does not name its issue code(s): GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE

ledger.claim: No independent corroboration of a deviation exists under POL-RD-07(ii), so the deviation cannot be established on this record and the rider cannot be defeated on it either. The chat log carries no driver admission: its only two messages are 'going KPE ah boss' and 'ok', and the log is impaired — EV-CHAT-00110 carries weight 0.6 with issue code TRUNCATED_LOG, so everything said after 18:26:14, 2186 seconds before the trip ended, is simply absent from the export and its silence proves nothing.

There is no gantry corroboration either. The fare breakdown's erp_gantries field is null against a non-zero tolls_erp of 3.00 (EV-FARE-00110 is impaired, weight 0.75, issue code PARTIAL_RECORD), so no set of charged gantries can be used to place the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use. The one artifact POL-RD-07(ii) needs to carry the corroboration is empty.

The counterparty statement does not admit a deviation. The driver says only that he 'took the KPE like always' — and the KPE is precisely the corridor the booked optimal route itself uses, the trip_record recording the optimal as 'KPE then ECP, crossing both gantries'. A statement that the driver travelled the optimal corridor cannot corroborate a departure from it under POL-RD-07(ii).

The trip_record cannot supply the independent distance POL-RD-07(ii) asks for. Its actual_distance_km of 21.20 is identical to the trace figure and, as the admissibility note states, is itself derived from the impaired trace; POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the governing field and bars actual_distance_km from the threshold test. The platform therefore holds no unimpaired measurement of this trip's distance at all.
ledger.detail: the claim cites impaired artifact EV-GPS-00110 at weight_multiplier 0.39 but does not name its issue code(s): GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE

ledger.claim: With the trace impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c) and no corroborating artifact of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names anywhere on the record, POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) are engaged. The Judge must not issue a final ruling: the case must ESCALATE to a human reviewer with the disputed amount held rather than collected. Absence of proof here is a data failure, not a finding for the driver, and the clause says in terms that the outcome is ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION.
ledger.detail: the claim cites impaired artifact EV-GPS-00110 at weight_multiplier 0.39 but does not name its issue code(s): GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE

ledger.claim: The driver's explanation — that his phone loses signal in the tunnel — is an external-cause assertion, and POL-RD-13 requires such an assertion to be tested against the traffic_advisory for this trip and nothing else. EV-ADVIS-00110-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT: no LTA advisory covers the KPE or the ECP in the 18:19-19:02 window. The comparison cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and under POL-RD-08 the assertion carries no weight and neither reduces the measured excess nor supplies an amended optimal.

On a rider-filed dispute, NO_ACTION is party-relative and leaves the charge exactly where it is: fare_breakdown.payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00, so the full $34.42 stays collected. ESCALATE is the only outcome available on this record that holds the disputed amount rather than collecting it. The rider asks for the escalation the impaired evidence compels, and does not ask the tribunal to invent a threshold finding the trace cannot support.
ledger.detail: the claim cites impaired artifact EV-FARE-00110 at weight_multiplier 0.75 but does not name its issue code(s): PARTIAL_RECORD

ledger.claim: POL-RD-08's enhanced-corroboration condition cannot be turned against this rider. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, far short of the four-claims-and-one-or-fewer-substantiated test, so no corroboration beyond the gps_trace may be demanded of this claim on profile grounds, and POL-GEN-01 confines the field to that one test.

No deviation is established under POL-RD-01. The governing figure is gps_trace.trace_distance_km, 21.2 km, against the booked optimal of 18.4 km — an excess of 2.8 km, or 15.2% of optimal. POL-RD-01 requires the excess to exceed BOTH 20% of optimal and 0.8 km; the percentage gate fails, so no deviation exists and the rider's claim falls at the threshold. Disclosed: EV-GPS-00110 is IMPAIRED (GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE) at weight 0.39; the impairment sits inside the tunnel gap and does not alter the driver-favourable total that POL-RD-07(i) mandates.

The sole gap in the trace is a 428-second dropout inside the KPE tunnel, far over POL-RD-07's 90-second limb, so the trace is impaired for policy purposes. POL-RD-07(i) then fixes the excess across that stretch as the straight line between the bounding fixes — the reading most favourable to the driver — producing the same 21.2 km total, still under the POL-RD-01 gate. No surface-route figure appears in the trace, and nothing in the bundle supports the 25.50 km hypothesis. Disclosed: EV-GPS-00110 is IMPAIRED (GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE) at weight 0.39.

POL-RD-08 places the initial burden on the rider to show an excess above the POL-RD-01 threshold, measured from an unimpaired trace or from an independent source of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names. The rider does neither: her claim concedes she 'did not watch the route' and states no measurement at all, and every distance figure in the bundle is the trace or a copy of it. Disclosed: the trace, EV-GPS-00110, is IMPAIRED (GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE) at weight 0.39.

No independent source corroborates any detour. The chat log records the driver announcing 'going KPE ah boss' — the KPE, which trip_record.optimal_route_source confirms lies on the optimal corridor ('optimal is KPE then ECP') — and the rider answering 'ok'; nothing admits a diversion, and the export was truncated before any later messages. Disclosed: EV-CHAT-00110 is IMPAIRED (TRUNCATED_LOG) at weight 0.6, and EV-FARE-00110's distance_charged_km of 21.20 copies the trace figure, so it is not independent corroboration under POL-RD-07(ii).
ledger.detail: the claim cites impaired artifact EV-FARE-00110 at weight_multiplier 0.75 but does not name its issue code(s): PARTIAL_RECORD

ledger.claim: Nothing falls to be corrected under POL-RD-09(4). The $3.00 of ERP charged equals the trip record's optimal_route_erp_sgd of $3.00 on the KPE-ECP optimal route, so it is a pass-through on the corridor actually optimal, not a phantom gantry the trace never crossed. Disclosed: EV-FARE-00110 is IMPAIRED (PARTIAL_RECORD) at weight 0.75; the absent gantry itemisation is a record gap, not a wrongly charged line.

Even if the rider's figures were accepted and a material deviation found, POL-RD-06's pattern test fails: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 744 completed_trips_90d, so no pattern is established and neither the FULL_REFUND uplift nor the conduct referral follows. POL-GEN-01 confines that test to deviation_flags_90d and makes the lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter context only.
flags: context-only profile field mentioned in claim text: prior_deviation_flags

ledger.claim: The disposition that protects the driver is to leave the charge standing: the rider filed, fare_breakdown.payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00, so NO_ACTION preserves the fare the driver earned under POL-GEN-03. And on no view does the rider recover — POL-RD-07(iii) directs that a claim left unproven by an impaired trace be held rather than paid, and POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at the 0.39 weight the deciding distance carries. Disclosed: EV-GPS-00110 is IMPAIRED (GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE) at weight 0.39.
